'''Maraghei''' ([[Tati language (Iran)|Tati]]: {{lang|fa|مراغی، مراقی}}) is a dialect of the [[Tati language (Iran)|Tati language]],<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Maraghei |url=https://glottolog.org/resource/languoid/id/mara1373 |access-date=11 December 2025 |website=Glottolog}}</ref><ref>[https://archive.org/details/TatiMaraghi  Maraghei dialect of Mushqin, Hossein Ali Rasouli, 1990, University of Tehran (Persian)]</ref><ref>Stilo, D. 1981: "The Tati dialects in the Sociolinguistic Context of Northwestern Iran and Transcaucasia" In: ''Iranian Studies'' 14.3/4, 137-187.</ref><ref>Iranian languages of Alamut, Professor Ehsan Yarshater, 1969, Munich</ref> spoken in the [[Gilan Province]], and upper Rudbar area ([[Rudbar-e Alamut District|Rudbar-e Alamut]]). The Maraghei Tati is closely related to [[Talysh language|Talysh]] and [[Gozarkhani language|Gozarkhani]], and falls under the ''Central Tatic'' (spoken in the [[Qazvin Province]]) subgroup.<ref>{{Cite web|title = Glottolog 2.6 - Maraghei|url = http://glottolog.org/resource/languoid/id/mara1373|website = glottolog.org|accessdate = 2016-01-02}}</ref> One dialect spoken is ''Dikini'', there are also various other dialects.
